title: Short Swords 4 PVP
description: Just a small resource pack that makes the swords short the way most pvp resource packs make them.
body:
# Short Swords 4 PVP
it just makes the Swords Short like the rest of the PVP texture packs
![All the short swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6d28d9b4c513f50df23cb95c38b5fc4470b1bbb.png)
# Versions
There is a new version which is for 1.21.9+
There is also an older version for 1.8.9 for the people who prefer the older mechanics for combat.
